title: symphyotrichum novi-belgii var. litoreum
intro: Symphyotrichum novi-belgii var. litoreum, commonly known as coastal New York aster, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that may aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions attributed to Symphyotrichum novi-belgii var. litoreum include its ability to reduce inflammation, inhibit bacterial growth, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
